description: Modular cross-platform C++20 UI and rendering framework (Windows, Linux, macOS, WebAssembly, ULTRA OS) with sibling modules for AI (UltraAI), networking (UltraNet), databases (UltraDatabase) and file loading (FileLoader).
rules: UltraCanvas is C++20; all identifiers use PascalCase
Widgets are std::shared_ptr-managed; prefer factory helpers such as CreateButton(...) over raw make_shared
Consult Docs/UltraCanvas/<Component>*.md before using a component; do not invent APIs
Framework code lives in namespace UltraCanvas; apps bootstrap via UltraCanvasApplication
Public engines are wrapped behind UltraCanvas-owned APIs (e.g. UltraCanvasJSON wraps yyjson); never call vendored third-party libraries directly from application code
UltraNet and UltraDatabase: TLS verification is on by default; blocking operations return UltraNetResult/UltraDbResult; SQL uses parameter binding only
